lines.text: Surface.
Reclamation Site 01.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Move all the food to storage, and don't forget to put the nutrium in the refrigerator.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Has the ammunition arrived? Ah, here it is. Transfer 90 percent of it to the armory, and take the other 10 to the dormitory.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Neon! Hands off those chocolate bars.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: B-but I brought these separately.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Then why does it say "For Military Use" on the wrapper?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: ... Because it's a new military edition flavor?

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: And pray tell, what exactly does the military taste like?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: ... Taxes?

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: *Sigh*

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Anis! Check the bottom of that box! It's leaking.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What? Oh jeez, it is!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Dang it, how many times has this happened already? What the hell are these robots doing to these deliveries to bang them up so badly?

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: No one ever said bringing supplies up to the surface would be easy.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: The delivery robots have to avoid Rapture routes, which demands that they traverse through all manner of rough terrain.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Supplies rarely arrive fully intact,

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: not to mention how much of it goes missing.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: The real bummer is that there's no elevator.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: When is the one they're building going to be finished?

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Not sure. Mighty Tools have commenced construction, that's all I know.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: It could take as little as a month, or as long as three.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: A month should be enough. This is Mighty Tools we're talking about here.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: I think so too.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Anis! Don't just leave that there. Pick them up and take them with you.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I was gonna pick them up once I put the rest of this stuff away. If I stop right now while I'm in the middle of something, it'll take longer.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Neon, put those combat rations down. If you eat those raw, they'll expand in your stomach and you definitely don't want that.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Gasp!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Commander. I've confirmed receipt of the third round of supplies.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: With this, we have the basics covered.
Excellent. Well done.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: All that's left to do is wait for the reinforcements to arrive.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: It's been some time since they left, so they should be arriving soon.
You said we should be expecting three people, right?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Yes, all of them are personnel who specialize in exploring.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: One of them is affiliated with Missilis. Will that be an issue?
That should be fine.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Roger that.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: ... By the way, thanks to Raptilion's generous gift,

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: we have an idea of where to start now.
It was a big help, that's for sure.
3 weeks ago.
Red Hood's hometown.
*Squeak Squeak*
Once Mother Whale lands, one of its sides opens slightly. Out of the opening comes something which vaguely resembles a Rapture.
As it lumbers clumsily over to us, it speaks out.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Hey there, friends! It's been a long time!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: How have you been?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Wow, it has been a hot minute, hasn't it?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Uh... can someone explain to me what's happening?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Stay alert, Commander.
It's okay. Raptilion is friendly.
Who is that, again? Or, what, rather?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I can't believe I'm actually saying this,

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: but I think we're safe as well.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: His name is Raptilion. A self-professed animal-lover and Rapture enthusiast.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: This contraption you're looking at is a Rapture suit he rigged up himself in order to communicate with Raptures.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Unfortunately, he was apparently a bit too aggressive in his approach, and ended up getting into hot water with the Central Government.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: In the end, however, he did succeed in establishing a line of communication with these creatures, and now Mother Whale is apparently allowing him to fly along with it.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I thought he had died...

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I knew you could do it!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: This is an extraordinary development.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I wouldn't believe it if I weren't seeing it with my own eyes.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Haha, I can understand why you'd all be taken aback.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I'll explain everything, so won't you help me a bit?
What is it that you need?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I haven't eaten anything for 5 days now.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: If it's not too much trouble, could you scrounge me up some grub?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Even if it's just something to drink, I'd be eternally grateful.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Wha... he fainted!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Get him some water!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: B-but I don't have a canteen or anything!
Here!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Quickly!
Where should I pour the water?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I don't see his mouth or anything like that...
Try and remember the features of the Rapture suit.
Try and find a gap to pour the water.
I rack my brain in an attempt to recall how the Rapture suit he is wearing works.
If I were to guess, his face should be in...
Here!
I pour some water through a small gap in the Rapture suit.
Due to the suit's haphazard construction, it is riddled with innumerable gaps.
His face is probably somewhere near the core, so I'll try and pour some water in there for now.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Phew!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I nearly bought the farm back there.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Thanks, friends!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Sorry to ask another favor, but could I ask for some food as well?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: First off, let's get inside.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: That might be a better place for you to fill us in on some details.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Okay, sure! Good idea.
After taking some food and slipping it through one of the gaps in the Rapture suit,
Raptilion focuses on eating for a while,
and after 20 minutes or so, is finally ready to have a conversation.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I've been traveling the world on Whaley's back for a while now.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Whaley?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You're not talking about that Mother Whale we just saw, are you?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I sure am! Isn't it a lovely name?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: ... I can't even.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I'll tell you one thing: seeing the surface from high up in the sky on Whaley's back is spectacular!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: It's far different from what we typically think of as the surface.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: A City full of sparkling crystals.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Refractions on a silver lake wriggling like a living thing.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Towering mountains made of steel.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: And so much more. It's a big, beautiful world out there.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: It's so amazing, in fact, that it's easy to forget about eating, like yours truly did.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Are you talking about the areas of the surface which are further out from the Ark?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Humanity is so deeply ensconced in the Ark, that we have no concept of what's out there in the world.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: But not me! I've seen it. I've seen the changes in the outside world.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Wow...

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: There's a whole lot that I still haven't seen. I'm super curious about what it all looks like beyond the beyond.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Well, it's nice to hear that you're doing well.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Yeah, I thought you were in trouble.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Me too, especially after seeing you get dragged off by Mother Whale.
I'm glad you're safe, and even more so that you seem to be enjoying yourself.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Hehe, thanks, you guys.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: How did you end up here, anyway?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I was flying around this area when I suddenly heard a loud noise.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: When I came to investigate, I saw you guys fighting a large horde of Raptures.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I hated seeing my friends in danger, so I swooped down to help.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Thank you for saving us, but...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: don't you like the Raptures? Aren't you torn up about decimating that horde?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: It hurts, sure, but I had no choice.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Most of the Raptures, at least in their current incarnation, aren't ready to communicate with us.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I have a fondness for the Raptures, yes,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: but you guys are my friends, and I care about you.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: ... Thank you.
Mother Whale... I mean, Whaley's appearance seems to have changed.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Nice observation!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I persuaded Whaley to make some cosmetic alterations.
What do you mean?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Whaley occasionally descends to ground level in order to eat,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: but her diet is way too animal-heavy.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I brought up the idea of maybe being vegetarian,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: and once she started incorporating more fruits and grass into her diet, her physical appearance changed too.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You're telling me that you can actually communicate with that thing? Okay fine, let's say that's true.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You're also saying that a change in diet made its exterior change?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: In my humble opinion as both an animal lover and Rapture connoisseur,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I believe its physical transformation was brought about by its change in diet, yes.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Is that even possible?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: It would seem so. Isn't it interesting?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I'd say so! Not as interesting as you mentioning it off-hand and moving on as if it were nothing!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Such are the mysteries of nature.
*Beeeeeeep*

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Ah, I think Whaley wants to leave now.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I'd love to take you along for a ride, but Whaley is still quite shy around others.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I'll try and persuade her to take you next time, so you can look forward to that.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Oooh, really?!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Of course!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: That'd be amazing! I'm gonna be up all night thinking about it!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Also, {AccountData.NickName}.
Yes?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I'd like to give you this.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: It's a map of everything I've seen up until now.
Really?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Yep! From my unique vantage point up on Whaley, I've drawn each and every single detail I've come across.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I hope that looking at this will fill you with inspiration, and a desire to explore that wide and wonderful world out there.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I want to bestow the greatness of nature's bounty and the wonders of this world to those I care about.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: It would be best if you venture out and see them for yourself. The sights out there are worth the risk.
A large piece of folded paper emerges from one of the gaps in the suit.
As I take it and spread the map wide open,
it is far larger than I imagined it would be.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Your cartography skills are remarkable. The detail here is rather intricate.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Of course! These things are a must if you're a fan of the natural world.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I still can't believe this is all really happening...

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Oh, you better believe it! It's very real.
Thank you, I'm sure this will come in handy.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I certainly hope so!
*Beeeeeeep*

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Oh boy, there she goes again. I better get going.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Next time we meet, I'll have another map for you.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Be well, friends,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: and see you again!
